visual_plan: style: FLAT skin for the whole reel (owner's choice; bright, clean flat office colours suit a slapstick office comedy). No skin switches needed; the two FREEZE moments (L8 record scratch, L12 DONK) are freeze frames with a flat colour flash, not a new skin. Setting: a generic small Hyderabad IT office (NOT Tower B, so it stays apart from the Nikhil/Ananya stories): open-plan cubicles, a big wall clock, a board 'OFFICE TIME: 10:00 AM', the manager's glass cabin with a door plate 'MANAGER' (no name, no company name, no logos or brands anywhere).

CAST (new, one-off): Ramesh, late 20s: light-blue shirt (slightly untucked), messy uneven hair tufts, a black backpack, a dark-grey half-face bike helmet (in his hand in Scene 1; on his desk in the background in Scene 3), an ID lanyard 'RAMESH'. Manager, ~45: white shirt neatly tucked in, a maroon tie, a thick black moustache, slightly bald (receding top, grey temples), a small paunch, a plain white coffee mug (no text or logo) in his hand in every manager shot. Silent colleagues: 3 generic office workers who pop up over cubicles (L6, L8). Gopi: corner cut-out for his narration lines only (L4, L5, L13, L14).

CONSISTENCY TABLE (identical in every frame, the caption and youtube.md): arrival '10:10 AM', office time '10:00 AM', '10 నిమిషాలు' late; the rating stamp 'RATING: TOP → SECONDARY'; tomorrow '1 hour early'. No numbers for the salary (only 'DOUBLE?').

Intro 0.0-1.5 s (silent, no voice): text hook '10:10 AM ⏰' big on screen from frame 1; the wall clock's minute hand ticks onto 10:10 (TING) beside the 'OFFICE TIME: 10:00 AM' board. Ramesh tiptoes in, backpack on, helmet in hand, hair a mess. Title pill 'OFFICE COMEDY 😂' lands ~1.0 s in.
L1 hook: whip-pan to the manager standing at the cabin door with the mug (whoosh). On 'ఏంట్రా' a punch-in zoom + screen shake (DHOOM); a flat red 'LATE!' burst behind the manager.
L2 excuse: Ramesh freezes mid-tiptoe, turns with a guilty grin, holds up ten fingers (bloop). Small chip: '10 నిమిషాలే 🙏'.

L3 plant: the manager waves it off with one hand, sips (slurp), then slowly narrows his eyes over the mug; on 'చూసుకుందాం' the lights dim to one cold spot on him (dun-DUNN). Calendar pages flip away (whoosh) to Scene 2.

L4 rating-stamp (Scene 2): a calendar card 'APPRAISAL DAY'. A big flat rating form 'RAMESH · RATING:' with 'TOP ⭐' glowing; drumroll; on 'secondary' a huge rubber STAMP slams 'SECONDARY' over it, screen shake, and the big text 'RATING: TOP → SECONDARY' (TOP crossed out). Ramesh's face droops during the sad trombone; one flat grey raincloud over his head.
L5 follow: the animated FOLLOW button pops up by Gopi's cut-out and gets tapped (tap + ding). On 'ఇప్పుడే' Ramesh marches toward the glass cabin (3 stomps) and bangs the door open.

L6 confront (Scene 3): inside the cabin. Ramesh at the desk, hands on it, angry but polite; three colleague heads pop up over the cubicle wall behind the glass ('ooooh'). The manager leans back in his chair, mug in hand.

L7 reason: the manager sweetly nods on 'బాగానే ఉంది', then taps the wall clock behind him on 'పది నిమిషాలు'. After 'కదా!' the TV-serial triple zoom on Ramesh's shocked face (DHAN! DHAN! DHAAAN!), a flat colour flash on each zoom.

L8 outburst: on 'ఒరేయ్…' Ramesh slaps the desk; at the onset of 'నీ దుంప తెగ' RECORD SCRATCH and FREEZE FRAME (slight desaturation, a 'paused' feel, everything still) while he says it; the big text 'నీ దుంప తెగ!' stamps over the freeze. Colleagues gasp; unfreeze on 'పది నిమిషాలు' as he rants with both hands.
L9 ask: the manager, unmoved, shrugs and takes a long slurp; Ramesh glares.
L10 promise: Ramesh straightens, chest out, a flat sunrise-ray background behind him for 1 s (mock heroic); chip '⏰ 1 hour early'.
L11 trap: the manager beams and raises the mug like a toast, a sparkle on his bald patch (ding). Then everything goes silent for 0.4 s.

L12 punch: Ramesh leans across the desk, deadpan; chip '₹ DOUBLE?' with a 😂 sticker. On the DONK the manager's face goes blank (dot eyes, mouth a flat line, the mug frozen mid-air, one eye-twitch); the laugh track and HOORAY roll: the three colleague heads cheer behind the glass with confetti.

Punch card (silent, ~2.5 s, laugh tail underneath): a flat full-screen card types in two halves: 'ఆఫీస్‌లో టైమ్‌కి విలువ ఉంటుంది...' then 'కానీ ఉద్యోగి టైమ్‌కి విలువ ఉండదు! 😂' (rimshot on the second half). Not voiced, on purpose: the laugh carries it.
L13 comment: comment bubbles pop up with the text 'మీ manager ఇలా చేశాడా? 😂 COMMENT చేయండి!' (example bubbles: '😂😂', 'Same here bro', 'Literally my manager' — no real usernames).
